eventDetail.scope: The 10th International Conference on Trends in Electronics and Informatics (ICOEI 2027) encourages seamless integration of electronics and informatics to enable innovations in various fields such as IoT, edge computing, and sustainable technologies. As technologies like human augmentation, digital twins, and advanced robotics gain prominence, the theme of 10th ICOEI 2027 will be "Navigating the Frontiers: Unleashing the Potential of Electronics and Informatics" with a focus on creating more efficient, secure, and human-centric systems, laying the foundation for a transformative era marked by intelligent connectivity, data-driven insights, and sustainable solutions.
